lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Hey! It is me. I finished the rehearsal early, and I actually asked for this break.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You asked for time off to practice your deck? Your manager agreed?

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Yes. I did not sneak out. I told her this matters to me, even when nobody is watching.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: I have a few new openings to test. There is no audience to impress. Would you like to join me sometime?

choices.label: I would like that. Let us set a time.
choices.reply: Deal! We can play when we both have room for it.

choices.label: Not right now, but thanks for asking.
choices.reply: No pressure. I am proud I could ask you honestly.
